capabilities: Play audio files inside notes with adjustable volume, speed, looping, and chunked sections
Add timestamped comments to an audio file, formatted as LRC
Jump to a timestamp by clicking its comment, and edit or delete comments via right-click
Control playback and comment insertion through Obsidian commands and keyboard shortcuts
Configure per-embed options (source, layout, sticky controls, autoplay) via a modal
extras: Interface is localized in en, it, zh-cn, es, and pt-br; the README invites contributions for more languages and mentions custom player layouts can be made.
problem: Obsidian can embed audio but offers no way to annotate specific timestamps or jump between them from within a note.
summary: Audio player for notes that plays vault audio files and attaches clickable, millisecond-precise timestamped comments stored as LRC.
